metadata.document_title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

article.title: Burden of proof.
article.content:
155Burden of proof.

Section 155  ·  Chapter XXI  ·  page 118 of the Act
Where any person claims that he is eligible for input tax credit under this Act, the burden of proving such claim shall lie on such person.
